title: Postoperative vital-sign summaries and sampling resolution: analysis code
description: Analysis source accompanying the study: Early postoperative vital-sign summaries for 28-day mortality prediction after major abdominal surgery: external validation and sampling resolution. MIMIC-IV development and SICdb external evaluation; 12-hour landmark and separate within-SICdb sampling-resolution comparisons. Patient-level data, predictions and fitted model objects are not included. Runtime and reproduction limits are described in REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
